faq.q: How does offline PDF compression work?
faq.a: CoolTools uses pdf-lib to re-serialize page trees into next-generation PDF Object Streams. This removes redundant headers, metadata, and duplicate references directly in browser memory.

faq.q: Will my PDF lose image quality?
faq.a: No. Our browser-based serializer strips metadata structure bloat rather than aggressively downsampling your images, preserving document readability.
